author: Okkerka
name: Deepwoken
short: Look up weapons and rank every weapon usable by a multi-stat build.
description: Provides public Deepwoken prefix/slash weapon lookup and sustained-DPS ranking, with bot-owner-only list updates and reloads.
install_msg: Installed. Use [p]dwweapon <name> or [p]dwweapon heavy 100 medium 100 prof 6. Owners: [p]dwweapon updatelist or [p]dwreload. To enable slash commands: [p]slash enablecog Deepwoken then [p]slash sync. Use /dwweapon query:<name or build stats>.
